NEW MACHINE OR TYPE OF WORK
20.01. It is agreed the Company has the unilateral right to establish new jobs and to determine the job duties of each employee.

Non Bargaining unit employees shall not perform work on a job customarily performed by an employee of the bargaining unit, except there shall be no restrictions upon work performed by non-bargaining unit employees in the instruction and/or training of employees, trouble-shooting, experimental work in connection with the development of new products, nor or changed equipment or procedures, or in work performed in emergencies, or affecting or threatening to affect the safety of persons, building or equipment, or on work which is negligible in amount and which also, under the circumstances then existing, it would be unreasonable to assign to a bargaining unit employee.
